rows.text: Timken is increasing its 2026 outlook, with full-year earnings per diluted share now forecasted to be in the range of $4.05 to $4.20 and adjusted earnings per diluted share to the range of $6.35 to $6.50.

Timken is updating its 2026 outlook, with full-year earnings per diluted share now forecasted to be in the range of $3.75 to $4.05 and is raising its adjusted earnings per diluted share to the range of $6.05 to $6.35.
